summary.text: Will Johanson is the Libertarian Party nominee for Idaho's 2nd Congressional District. A U.S. Navy nuclear operator turned engineer, he now works in Idaho's semiconductor industry, and he advanced from the Libertarian primary on May 19, 2026.

paragraphs.text: According to his campaign website, Johanson was born and raised in California's Central Valley, and his interest in liberty began during Ron Paul's 2008 presidential campaign.
He enlisted in the U.S. Navy as a nuclear operator and served aboard the USS Georgia as an Engineering Laboratory Technician, separating in 2020 as a Machinist's Mate (Nuclear) First Class (E-6).
Johanson used the GI Bill to earn bachelor's and master's degrees in Materials Science & Engineering from Boise State University, according to his campaign website.
He works as an engineer in Idaho's semiconductor industry, and his campaign is headquartered in Boise.
